description:
Extract structured data from a webpage via Zenrows.

Prefer this over scrape when you need JSON fields (products, articles, listings)
rather than a full page body.
Modes:
- auto (default): extract=auto — site-tailored Extract (open beta; currently free,
  billing may apply later; may fall back to autoparse if the domain is not enabled)
- autoparse: general-purpose structured JSON on any domain
- css: css_extractor with an explicit selector map

Stealth: js_render, premium_proxy, proxy_country, or mode_auto (Adaptive Stealth Mode).
For full-page markdown/HTML/screenshots, use scrape instead.

css_extractor.description: Required when mode=css. JSON map of field→selector, e.g. '{"title":"h1","price":".price"}'

fallback_autoparse.description: When mode=auto and the domain is not in Extract open beta (AUTH010), retry once with autoparse (default true)

js_render.description: Enable headless JS rendering (SPAs / dynamic content)

mode.description: Extraction mode: auto (extract=auto, default), autoparse, or css (requires css_extractor)

mode_auto.description: Enable Adaptive Stealth Mode (mode=auto) for tougher sites

premium_proxy.description: Use premium residential proxies (anti-bot). Higher credit cost.

proxy_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Requires premium_proxy or mode_auto.

url.description: The webpage URL to extract from

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after load. Requires js_render.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting. Requires js_render.

name: extract
